description: Backend question-bank + rubric domain for Step 3. Add the embedding-index migration, a pure question-status state machine, a swappable mock embedding adapter, rewrite questionService/repository for the new fields + lifecycle + near-duplicate warning + Excel import, extend rubricService/repository for performance-levels + lock + clone, wire everything in createApp with LECTURER guards, and cover it all with fake-repo unit tests. Independent of FEAT-002 except that FEAT-002 consumes these endpoints, so FEAT-001 must land first.
steps: Add migration backend/db/migrations/012_question_embedding_index.sql: `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_question_embedding ON question USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops);` mirroring 006_materials.sql. Do NOT touch applied migrations 001-011. (It auto-runs on boot via backend/src/db/migrationRunner.js; no column is added because 007 already provides every Step-3 column and 'question purpose' is stored in the existing rationale JSONB as rationale.purpose.)

Add backend/src/domain/questionStatus.js: pure module exporting STATUSES = ['DRAFT','PENDING_REVIEW','APPROVED','REJECTED','ARCHIVED'], a transition map {DRAFT:[PENDING_REVIEW,APPROVED,ARCHIVED], PENDING_REVIEW:[APPROVED,REJECTED,DRAFT], APPROVED:[ARCHIVED,PENDING_REVIEW], REJECTED:[DRAFT,ARCHIVED], ARCHIVED:[]}, canTransition(from,to), assertTransition(from,to) (throws Error with statusCode 409 code 'INVALID_TRANSITION'), and isExamEligible(status) (status === 'APPROVED').

Add embedding adapter under backend/src/embedding/: cosineSimilarity.js exporting cosineSimilarity(a,b); mockEmbeddingAdapter.js exporting a class/factory with embed(text) returning a deterministic L2-normalized 1024-length number[] seeded from normalized text (same normalized text => identical vector, different text => different vector); embeddingAdapter.js exporting createEmbeddingAdapter(env) that returns the mock when env.embeddingProvider is 'mock' or unset (clean seam so Step 4 can add a real Titan provider). Add `embeddingProvider: process.env.EMBEDDING_PROVIDER || 'mock'` to backend/src/config/env.js.

Extend backend/src/repositories/questionRepository.js: insert/update the new columns (bloom_level, language, reference_answer, key_points JSONB, source, status, rationale JSONB, embedding, created_by, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, review_note); add findAllFiltered({status,bloom,source}); add updateStatusFields(id,{status,reviewedBy,reviewedAt,reviewNote,rubricId}); add findSameSubjectEmbeddings(questionId, excludeId) that joins question->topic to scope by topic.subject_id and returns rows with question_id + embedding. Keep the existing findByNormalizedContent exact-duplicate query unchanged.

Rewrite backend/src/services/questionService.js: constructor { repository, embeddingAdapter, rubricRepository, topicRepository }. toApiQuestion maps all new fields (purpose read from rationale.purpose). createQuestion: validate fields (bloom in STATUSES-independent Bloom set REMEMBER/UNDERSTAND/APPLY/ANALYZE, language, key_points array), keep exact-duplicate hard 409 (DUPLICATE_QUESTION), compute embedding + cosine vs same-subject questions and attach a NON-blocking warning {type:'NEAR_DUPLICATE',questionId,similarity} when >= 0.9, default status APPROVED when content+topic+rubric present else DRAFT, store purpose into rationale.purpose, persist embedding; return { question, warnings }. updateQuestion keeps existing-not-found + duplicate checks and new fields. listQuestions(filters) uses findAllFiltered. approve(id,{reviewedBy}) asserts transition to APPROVED and requires rubric_id present (else 400/409 code 'RUBRIC_REQUIRED'); reject(id,{reason,reviewedBy}) requires reason (else 400 'REASON_REQUIRED') and sets REJECTED + review_note; archive(id) asserts transition to ARCHIVED. Use domain/questionStatus for all transitions.

Add Excel import to questionService: importQuestions(buffer) parsing columns content / topic code / Bloom / language / reference answer / key points (|-separated) / rubric code with exceljs, validating the WHOLE file first (content required; topic code resolves to a topic; Bloom in the allowed set; language non-empty; rubric code resolves to a rubric; in-file + DB exact-duplicate content), returning { ok:false, errors:[{row, errors:[...]}] } with ZERO writes on any error, else inserting every row as source='IMPORT' status='APPROVED' and returning { ok:true, created }. Add buildImportTemplate() returning an xlsx Buffer with just the header row. Mirror backend/src/services/adminService.js importStudents exactly for the all-or-nothing + per-row-error shape.

Extend backend/src/controllers/questionController.js + backend/src/routes/questionRoutes.js: list reads req.query {status,bloom,source}; add GET /questions/template (streams buildImportTemplate xlsx); add POST /questions/import reusing adminController.resolveImportBuffer semantics (raw body or base64) responding 422 with {ok:false,errors} / 201 with {ok:true,created}; add POST /questions/:id/approve, /questions/:id/reject (reason in body), /questions/:id/archive. Mount express.raw({type:[XLSX_MIME,'application/octet-stream'],limit:'10mb'}) on the import route like adminRoutes.js.

Extend rubric stack: backend/src/repositories/rubricRepository.js add performance_level reads/writes inside the rubric transaction (so update replaces criteria AND their levels), expose is_locked/version/subject_id on returned rows, and add clone(rubricId) that copies the rubric (version+1, is_locked=false) with its criteria + performance_levels; backend/src/services/rubricService.js accept nested performanceLevels per criterion (validate label required, numeric min_score<=max_score, integer order_no), block updateRubric when is_locked is true (409 code 'RUBRIC_LOCKED'), add cloneRubric(id); backend/src/controllers/rubricController.js + backend/src/routes/rubricRoutes.js add POST /rubrics/:id/clone.

Wire backend/src/app.js: build const embeddingAdapter = overrides.embeddingAdapter || createEmbeddingAdapter(runtimeEnv); pass { repository, embeddingAdapter, rubricRepository, topicRepository } into QuestionService; keep all existing override seams. Guard the write/lifecycle/import routes of /questions and /rubrics with app.authMiddleware.requireAuth + requireRole('LECTURER') (pass the middleware into createQuestionRouter/createRubricRouter the way createAdminRouter receives it; keep GET list/read behavior consistent and existing endpoints working).

Tests (fake-repo style; every new file name ends in Service.test.js so the `node --test "test/*Service.test.js"` glob runs it): rewrite backend/test/questionService.test.js to the new statuses/fields using injected fake repositories (no InMemoryDatabase); add backend/test/questionStatusService.test.js (every legal transition passes, representative illegal transitions throw INVALID_TRANSITION, isExamEligible only APPROVED); add backend/test/questionImportService.test.js (all-or-nothing: one bad row => zero writes + per-row error table; happy path => source IMPORT status APPROVED; template has the 7 headers); add backend/test/embeddingService.test.js (mock embed deterministic + 1024 dims + L2-normalized; cosine of identical normalized text >= 0.9 triggers warning, dissimilar text < 0.9 no warning; exact-duplicate still hard 409); extend backend/test/rubricService.test.js (lock prevents edit => RUBRIC_LOCKED; clone copies criteria + performance levels and bumps version; performance-level validation).
acceptance_criteria: From backend/, `npm test` passes with zero failures (74 baseline tests plus all new unit tests).
From backend/, `npm run test:e2e` stays green offline with Postgres suites self-skipping (no Docker).
questionService create returns a non-blocking NEAR_DUPLICATE warning when mock cosine >= 0.9 and still saves; exact-duplicate content is rejected with HTTP 409 code DUPLICATE_QUESTION.
approve rejects when no rubric is attached (RUBRIC_REQUIRED); reject rejects when no reason (REASON_REQUIRED); illegal status transitions throw INVALID_TRANSITION.
Question Excel import writes nothing when any row is invalid and returns a per-row error table; valid files create questions with source=IMPORT and status=APPROVED.
Rubric update is blocked when is_locked is true (RUBRIC_LOCKED); clone copies criteria + performance levels and increments version with is_locked=false.
Migration 012 adds an HNSW cosine index on question.embedding without editing any applied migration; migrations 001-011 are unchanged.

findings:
VERIFICATION: `npm test` => 104 unit tests pass, 0 fail (74 baseline + 30 new). `npm run test:e2e` => 78 passed, 7 skipped (the 2 Postgres suites migrations.e2e/jobQueue.e2e self-skip offline), 0 fail. App boots via createApp() with full DI.

MIGRATED E2E SUITES (approved Option A, open-write + Active/Draft contract is intentionally superseded by Step 2/3): backend/test/crud.e2e.test.js and backend/test/workflow.e2e.test.js now authenticate as a LECTURER (signed access cookie minted via app.authContext.tokenService.signAccess, exposed as t.lecturerCookie/t.studentCookie/t.authCookie() in createTestContext) and assert the new statuses/shape. Coverage was translated, not dropped: crud.e2e adds 401/403 auth checks, status-filter read, a full approve-requires-rubric / reject-requires-reason / INVALID_TRANSITION lifecycle test, and a rubric clone test; workflow.e2e adds a B3b unauthenticated-401 check. One offline-only caveat: the in-memory mock DB only round-trips topic/rubric/content/status for questions, so source/bloom/etc. are NOT asserted in the e2e suites (they ARE covered by the fake-repo unit tests). Reads (GET /questions, /rubrics) now require requireAuth (any logged-in user); writes/lifecycle/import require requireAuth + requireRole('LECTURER').

ENDPOINT SHAPES for FEAT-002:
- POST /questions and POST /questions/import success return a 201 ENVELOPE. Create: { question, warnings:[] }. Import: { ok:true, created:[question...] }. Import failure: 422 { ok:false, errors:[{row, errors:[string...]}] } with ZERO writes.
- GET /questions (list) and GET /questions/:id, PUT /questions/:id, POST /questions/:id/{approve,reject,archive}, DELETE /questions/:id all return a BARE question object (NOT wrapped). reject takes { reason } in body.
- Question object (toApiQuestion): { id, topicId, rubricId, content, status, bloomLevel, language, referenceAnswer, keyPoints:[], source, purpose, rationale, createdBy, reviewedBy, reviewedAt, reviewNote }. 'purpose' is read from rationale.purpose (stored in the rationale JSONB; no schema change).
- Statuses: DRAFT|PENDING_REVIEW|APPROVED|REJECTED|ARCHIVED. Create defaults to APPROVED when content+topic+rubric all present, else DRAFT; an explicit valid status wins. Bloom set: REMEMBER|UNDERSTAND|APPLY|ANALYZE. Source set: MANUAL|IMPORT|AI (create defaults MANUAL; import forces IMPORT).
- WARNING SHAPE (non-blocking, only on create): warnings[] contains at most one { type:'NEAR_DUPLICATE', questionId:<number>, similarity:<number 0..1> } when mock cosine >= 0.9 against a same-subject question; the question is still saved. Exact-duplicate normalized content stays a HARD 409 { code:'DUPLICATE_QUESTION' } (checked before the embedding scan).
- Lifecycle error codes: 409 RUBRIC_REQUIRED (approve without rubric), 400 REASON_REQUIRED (reject without reason), 409 INVALID_TRANSITION (illegal status move), 404 NOT_FOUND.
- GET /questions/template streams an xlsx (Content-Type xlsx, attachment) whose single header row has EXACTLY these 7 columns in order: ['Content','Topic Code','Bloom','Language','Reference Answer','Key Points','Rubric Code']. Import parses the same columns; Key Points is pipe('|')-separated; header matching is case-insensitive substring (content/topic/bloom/language/reference/key/rubric).
- POST /questions/import accepts a raw xlsx body (express.raw type xlsx/octet-stream, 10mb) OR JSON base64 under {file|data} (controller.resolveImportBuffer), mirroring adminController.

RUBRIC SHAPES for FEAT-002:
- toApiRubric: { id, maxScore, subjectId, version, isLocked, criteria:[{ id, name, weightPercent, description, performanceLevels:[{ id, label, minScore, maxScore, description, orderNo }] }] }.
- POST /rubrics/:id/clone returns 201 with the cloned rubric (version+1, isLocked=false, criteria + performance levels copied).
- updateRubric is blocked with 409 { code:'RUBRIC_LOCKED' } when is_locked=true. Criteria weightPercent must total 100 (preserved). Performance-level validation: label required, numeric minScore<=maxScore, integer orderNo.

REPOSITORY/IMPORT CODE RESOLUTION GAP (for FEAT-002): topicRepository.findByCode(code) resolves topic by topic.course_id. The rubric table has NO code column (migrations 001-011 are frozen, 012 is index-only), so rubricRepository.findByCode(code) treats the numeric rubric_id as the code; a real rubric code column may be wanted later. Embedding adapter is createEmbeddingAdapter(env) -> mock (env.embeddingProvider, env var EMBEDDING_PROVIDER, default 'mock'); Step 4 can add a Titan provider at that seam. Migration 012_question_embedding_index.sql adds the HNSW cosine index on question.embedding; 001-011 untouched.
